answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 20134 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to put up a residence on the open terrace of a masjid.The masjid is on the ground and first floor and the donor who has built this masjid in a school compound wants to stay here whenever he comes home from abroad,so that he can monitor the school activities.He visits once in six months and stays for a few days only. Question: assalam alaikum wa rahmatullah .. Is it permissible to put up a residence on the open terrace of a masjid.The masjid is on the ground and first floor and the donor who has built this masjid in a school compound wants to stay here whenever he comes home from abroad,so that he can monitor the school activities.He visits once in six months and stays for a few days only. Answer ID: 20134 Posted on: Aug 27, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 399/399/M=1431) If the open terrace of the mosque is included in the boundary of legal mosque, then staying there is not allowed. Yes, stay there is only allowed for traveller or one in itikaf (seclusion in mosque with the intention of reward) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
